d:
Watch the beautiful "Thaara O Thaara" Lyrical Video Song from the classic Kannada movie "Apoorva Sangama", featuring Dr. Rajkumar, Shankar Nag and Ambika.
The song is sung by Dr. Rajkumar and S. Janaki, with music composed by Upendra Kumar and lyrics penned by Chi. Udayashankar. Apoorva Sangama was directed by Y. R. Swamy.
Directed by: Y. R. Swamy
Produced by: Y. R. Swamy, Naveen Kumar
Written by: K.A. Narayan
Starring: Dr. Rajkumar, Shankar Nag, Ambika, T. N. Balakrishna, Thoogudeepa Srinivas
Music Director: Upendra Kumar
Cinematography: B. C. Gowrishankar
